a:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

Strict side view for a 2D side-scrolling game, the camera is level with the ground (not from above). Characters face RIGHT.
Tiles and background layers marked "connect seamlessly" must match exactly at the LEFT and RIGHT edges so they can repeat.
Mid layers: draw only the lower part, leave the upper part empty flat #FF00FF magenta.

TOAD GATEKEEPER: a wide squat TOAD shaped like an old metal FUSE BOX, the body is a grey-green #6F8A6A steel box with rounded corners and rivets.
A big red-handled BREAKER LEVER sticks up from the top of its head. Huge wide mouth (the box lid), pie-cut eyes on top bumps, an inflatable throat sac that glows yellow with electricity.
Stubby rubber hose legs with big webbed feet. About twice BOGLE's height. Loud, proud, a little dim, cartoonish.

SHEET COMPOSITION: Generate JOB-19 sheet a. Exactly FOUR isolated poses in ONE horizontal row, left to right in the order below, on pure solid #FF00FF magenta. Wide landscape canvas, high resolution, each character at least 300 pixels tall. Give each pose ample independent space; the third pose needs extra width for its very long tongue extending LEFT without touching pose two. All four are the SAME grey-green rounded metal fuse-box toad, same rivets, same eye bumps, same red-handled breaker lever anchored to the same crown location. Flat cel style matching reference image 1; reference image 2 is INKING STYLE ONLY, do not reproduce its character, typography or shadows. IMPORTANT DIRECTION EXCEPTION: these boss poses all face LEFT in strict ground-level side view, overriding generic RIGHT direction above. No floor or cast shadows. No labels, no grid, no color swatches. The fourth pose is conspicuously flattened and exhausted, with the roof breaker standing tall and unobstructed. Keep steam/sparks close to their own character. Distinct poses, clear silhouettes, funny original character.

Pose 1: TOAD GATEKEEPER sitting wide facing LEFT, puffed cheeks, lever on top of its head, smug half-closed eyes
Pose 2: TOAD GATEKEEPER croaking loudly facing LEFT, huge inflated throat sac glowing with electricity, small sparks shooting down to the floor
Pose 3: TOAD GATEKEEPER facing LEFT shooting out a very long tongue with a horseshoe magnet at the tip, curved pull lines, eyes squeezed
Pose 4: TOAD GATEKEEPER flattened and panting facing LEFT, steam puffs, the big breaker lever on top of its head clearly sticking up
